title: Cartesian maps over presheaf elements model limit extension
statement:
Use the coherent quasicategories, functors, full subcategories, spaces and equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and right-fibration classification of [lem-coef-space-transport-classification]. Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V\in\mathcal W$. Let $A$ be a $\mathcal U$-small quasicategory, let $\mathcal S$ be the $\mathcal U$-small spaces and set $\mathcal P(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(A^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$. Write $y(a)=\operatorname{Map}_A(-,a)$. Let $G:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal V}$ be any coherent functor and choose its Cartesian unstraightening $u:U_G\to A$, or its cocartesian unstraightening $v:V_G\to A^{\mathrm{op}}$. For $X\in\mathcal P(A)$ choose a $\mathcal U$-small right fibration $Y_X\to A$ classifying $X$. Let $\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{cart}}_A(Y_X,U_G)$ denote the full subcategory of the coherent functor category over $A$ on functors preserving Cartesian edges, and define $\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{cocart}}_{A^{\mathrm{op}}}(Y_X^{\mathrm{op}},V_G)$ analogously. Then both constructions
$$X\longmapsto\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{cart}}_A(Y_X,U_G),\qquad X\longmapsto\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{cocart}}_{A^{\mathrm{op}}}(Y_X^{\mathrm{op}},V_G)$$
define, up to coherent natural equivalence, the unique functor $\widehat G:\mathcal P(A)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\infty,\mathcal V}$ extending $G$ along $y^{\mathrm{op}}$ and carrying $\mathcal U$-small colimit cocones of presheaves to limit cones. For a transformation $X'\to X$, the induced functor is precomposition by $Y_{X'}\to Y_X$, or its opposite. The assertions include naturality in $G$, transformations and all higher simplices; no smallness of $\mathcal P(A)$ in $\mathcal U$ is required. All functor categories and unstraightenings are formed in the stated containing universes.
